spaCy-Rules.algorithmic_method: Lexical trigger matching with syntactic dependency subtree traversal, active/passive voice detection, and lexical negation/hedging detection.
spaCy-Rules.known_limitations: Brittle on non-standard syntactic inversions and complex multi-clause sentence structures.

KeywordHeuristic.algorithmic_method: Entity marker tokenization ([E1]...[/E1], [E2]...[/E2]) with regex keyword heuristics and device discovery (PyTorch MPS/CUDA/CPU).
KeywordHeuristic.known_limitations: Operates strictly as a fast heuristic baseline; lacks contextual semantic disambiguation.

audit_findings: No model weights (.pt, .bin, .safetensors) exist in the repository.
The class DistilBERTExtractor was an exact alias: DistilBERTExtractor = KeywordHeuristicExtractor.
Preserved historical file in backups/ for auditability, but excluded from multi-model tables and graph discovery.
FineTuned-DistilBERT.action_taken: Removed misleading claims of fine-tuned transformer. Marked genuine neural Transformer inference as future work.

Prompted-LLM-Gemini.algorithmic_method: Zero-shot / few-shot structured JSON prompting via Google Gemini REST API (gemini-3.5-flash) with local SHA-256 caching.
Prompted-LLM-Gemini.known_limitations: External API rate limits; evaluated as a pilot sample across 20 candidate pairs.

Prompted-LLM-Groq.algorithmic_method: Structured JSON prompting via Groq REST API (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) with local SHA-256 caching.
Prompted-LLM-Groq.known_limitations: Evaluated as a pilot sample across 20 candidate pairs.
